natural_language_statement: For a multivariate polynomial p over a commutative ring, dehomogenize is the ring homomorphism that sends the added variable indexed by none to 1 and relabels variables indexed by some i as i. Homogenize forms the sum of each homogeneous component of p, relabeled into the enlarged variable set, multiplied by the added variable to the complementary degree. Dehomogenization sends the added variable to 1, fixes relabeled polynomials, recovers p from homogenize p, and homogenize p is homogeneous of degree p.totalDegree.
explanation: The exported definitions and lemmas establish the standard algebraic relationship between a polynomial and its homogeneous lift with one extra variable. The recovery identity follows by evaluating the added variable at 1 and summing the homogeneous components; homogeneity follows termwise from each component's degree and the complementary power.
